newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Yield in two one-wk Czech cbank repos at 12.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield in two one-wk Czech cbank repos at 12.90 pct.

text.p: Maximum yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) one week American-style repo tender, from May 16 to May 23, hit 12.89 percent, the CNB said on Friday.
The maximum yield in a separate tender, from May 20 to May 27, hit 12.90 percent, the CNB added.
All bids in both tenders were accepted at the maximum yield, the central bank said.

The CNB raised the repo rate to 12.90 percent on Friday from 12.4 percent. After months of having a stable repo rate, the central bank said on Thursday that it would begin to set rates according to market conditions.
